name: @pryzm/geometry-siteworks
description: PRYZM — SITEWORKS geometry (roads, parking, pedestrian areas). The centreline sweep (the one C84 EI-1 authority that turns a linear surface into a ring), the footprint resolver that hides the linear/areal split from every consumer, and the single area answer. Pure: no THREE, no DOM, no I/O. C116 / ADR-0384.
